name: Omaha Virtual Cubing 2020

information:
# The competition is cancelled due to the COVID-19 outbreak.
Omaha Virtual School is hosting our second annual Speed Cube Competition!  This competition will help competitors qualify for the North American Championship in Toronto! We are excited to expand Speed Cubing in the midwest!
